name: @w6w-apps/feedly
description: Read team AI Feeds, folders and boards, search across them, and manage Feedly's enterprise webhooks.

w6w.longDescription:
Feedly's current public API is entirely the Feedly for Threat Intelligence (Enterprise) surface — every endpoint in this app lives under that product, and a self-service API token is only issued to Enterprise accounts (an admin generates it from https://feedly.com/i/team/api). There is no OAuth2 dance to build against: once an Enterprise team has a token, every call is a plain `Authorization: Bearer` header against api.feedly.com, so this app is a straightforward bearer-token integration — the gate is commercial (who can get a token), not technical (what the token can do).

Within that surface, this app covers the general content-reading and team-collaboration actions rather than the security-analyst-specific ones (CVE/threat-actor/malware insight cards, the Vulnerability/Cyberattacks/TTP Agents, entity lookups, Ask AI): collecting and searching articles across a team's AI Feeds, folders and boards, reading one or many articles' full enriched metadata, adding annotations, managing team boards and webhooks, and listing an enterprise account's folders, AI Feeds and users.
